name: The Resort at Pelican Hill
insider_take: This oceanfront masterpiece sits on 504 acres of pristine coastline, featuring the world's largest circular pool and architecture inspired by 16th-century Italian hill towns.
whats_special: The Resort at Pelican Hill boasts the iconic Coliseum Pool - a massive 136-foot diameter circular pool that's become a Newport Beach landmark. The property's Palladian-style villas and bungalows offer panoramic Pacific Ocean views, while the award-winning spa features Europe's only Acqua Colonna Watsu pool outside of Italy.
pro_tip: Book a sunset dinner at Andrea restaurant - it's consistently rated among Orange County's best and offers unobstructed ocean views from every table.
dont_miss: The resort's Tom Fazio-designed golf courses consistently rank among California's top layouts. Take advantage of the private beach access to Crystal Cove State Park, and don't skip the world-class wine cellar housing over 3,000 bottles from premier California vintners.
pros: Stunning oceanfront location with panoramic Pacific Ocean views
Award-winning spa and world-class golf course
Luxurious villa-style accommodations with private terraces
Exceptional dining experiences with multiple gourmet restaurants
cons: Resort fee and parking charges apply
